content:
“Tired of healing wounded arms and legs? The Adamantium Skeleton Perk will reduce all limb damage received.”— Loading screen perk description

**Adamantium Skeleton** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Reduced limb damage based on Endurance.

| ![FO76 adamantium skeleton perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/7/7a/FO76_adamantium_skeleton_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Endurance | Limb Damage Reduction | 
| | 1 | +10% | 
| | 15 | +35% | 
| | 30 | +60% | 
| | 60 | +90% | 
| | 100 | +100% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain Limb Damage Reduction based on your END. | 0004C92D | 

- This perk does not affect limb damage from falling. [verification overdue] 
- Update 56 reduced ranks from 3 to 1. Before this change Adamantium Skeleton provided 30%/60%/100% limb damage reduction.

This perk pays homage to *Marvel Comics* character Wolverine, who possesses an adamantium-laced skeleton, making his bones effectively indestructible.

Other perks that scale with Endurance include:

- Iron Stomach - Bonus damage and energy resistance
- Lead Belly - Less radiation from eating and drinking
- LifeGiver - Bonus HP
- Natural Resistance - Bonus elemental resistance
- Rad Resistant - Bonus radiation resistance
- Thirst Quencher - More AP
- Vaccinated - Higher disease resistance
